edits.text: 巾 is analyzed as 帮’s semantic component, in the same broad meaning class as 帛 in 幫. One account proposes that it arose by reducing 幫’s lower 帛; the variant analysis does not establish that graphic route.

帮 is classified as a variant of 幫. One account proposes that 幫’s lower 帛 was reduced to 巾 in 帮, while another analyzes the two forms with different semantic and phonetic components. The evidence does not establish when the variant arose or a step-by-step graphic route.
